issue.title: Uncaught TypeError when USelectMenu is teleported into a detached container
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Vue: 3.5.13

### Description

When the parent of a `USelectMenu` gets removed from the DOM right as the menu opens (e.g. a route change), I get a crash. The stack trace points entirely into reka-ui's positioning code, `USelectMenu` just re-exports it:

```
Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'getBoundingClientRect')
    at updatePosition (node_modules/reka-ui/dist/Popper/PopperContent.js:41:19)
    at node_modules/reka-ui/dist/Popper/PopperContent.js:12:5
    at flushCallbacks (node_modules/@vue/runtime-core/dist/runtime-core.cjs.js:311:7)
```

I can reproduce this with plain reka-ui too, outside of @acme/ui entirely, by unmounting the trigger's parent while the popper is positioning.

### Expected behavior

The positioning logic should bail out instead of throwing when its reference element is gone.
issue.author: felixq

upstreamCandidates.title: Popper throws when the reference element is removed mid-update
upstreamCandidates.body: getBoundingClientRect is called on a reference that can already be null if the element unmounts during a pending position update.
